exercises.title: Trust-boundary map
exercises.prompt: Map an avatar upload from request to storage and response; label sources, sinks, assumptions, and safe failure.
exercises.learning_objective: identify trust boundaries and safe defaults
exercises.learner_task: label three sources, two sinks, one authorization decision
exercises.completion_criteria: all labels justified and tests cover accepted/rejected behavior
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: explain who controls each value and which component interprets it

exercises.title: Grammar before regex
exercises.prompt: Define accepted username grammar, then test empty, Unicode, overlong, whitespace, and malformed values.
exercises.learning_objective: design an allowlist from feature requirements
exercises.learner_task: define grammar before writing regex and test edge cases
exercises.completion_criteria: empty, Unicode, length, whitespace, and malformed cases are classified
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: justify false positives and false negatives
exercises.instructor_debrief: contrast * with + and discuss Unicode policy

future_evidence_signal.possible_competency: validate input against a feature-specific allowlist

exercises.title: Interpreter boundary
exercises.prompt: Replace a free-form sort expression and unsafe regex use with fixed choices or literal handling.
exercises.starting_condition: synthetic handler with free-form sort and regex
exercises.learner_task: map approved values and use literal regex handling
exercises.completion_criteria: unknown sort is rejected and regex metacharacters remain data
exercises.common_mistake: deleting punctuation instead of constraining syntax
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: name the next interpreter and its grammar
exercises.instructor_debrief: compare replace with replaceAll and replacement semantics

exercises.title: Parameterized query
exercises.prompt: Refactor a query with a user value, limit, and selectable ordering.
exercises.learning_objective: parameterize values and map structural choices
exercises.completion_criteria: values are parameters and unknown identifiers fail closed
exercises.instructor_debrief: review result limits and database privilege

exercises.title: Context worksheet
exercises.prompt: Classify HTML text, attribute, URL, and JSON sinks and select a safe encoding/serialization approach.
exercises.learner_task: classify each sink and choose encoding/serialization
exercises.completion_criteria: HTML, attribute, URL, and JSON choices are distinct and justified
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: explain why validation is not encoding
exercises.instructor_debrief: compare safe textContent with raw output

exercises.title: Safe upload path
exercises.prompt: Replace direct use of getOriginalFilename with generated storage naming, containment, and authorization.
exercises.starting_condition: synthetic upload handler using client filename
exercises.learner_task: design identifier naming, base resolution, normalization, containment, and tests
exercises.expected_output: safe storage design and edge-case tests
exercises.completion_criteria: encoded, mixed-separator, dot, symlink, and authorization cases are addressed
exercises.common_mistake: treating a filename regex as complete defense
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: explain representation layers and final-object authorization
exercises.instructor_debrief: separate regex demonstration from filesystem defense hierarchy

exercises.title: Authorization matrix
exercises.prompt: Build owner/member/unrelated/admin/missing-user tests for a document update.
exercises.learning_objective: enforce object authorization independently of authentication
exercises.learner_task: define policy outcomes and server-side check
exercises.completion_criteria: another user’s object ID is denied and no-rule behavior is deny
exercises.common_mistake: checking only that a user is logged in
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: reason about subject, object, action, and policy
exercises.instructor_debrief: contrast authentication, ownership, role, and default deny

exercises.title: Session lifecycle
exercises.prompt: Harden login, logout, privilege change, and cookie configuration.
exercises.learning_objective: protect session lifecycle and cookie transport
exercises.starting_condition: synthetic login flow retaining pre-login ID
exercises.learner_task: specify rotation, expiry, revocation, and cookie flags
exercises.completion_criteria: login, privilege change, logout, idle expiry, and flags are covered
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: separate fixation, theft, CSRF, and authorization controls
exercises.instructor_debrief: walk the identifier through each lifecycle transition

exercises.title: Data minimization
exercises.prompt: Design response, trace, and log handling for a payment profile.
exercises.learner_task: classify fields across response, logs, traces, and retention
exercises.completion_criteria: each field has a justified handling decision
exercises.common_mistake: encrypting data that should not be collected
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: consider every copy and downstream system
exercises.instructor_debrief: include analytics, support exports, and crash data

exercises.title: Safe error path
exercises.prompt: Rewrite an exception handler that exposes messages and logs request bodies.
exercises.learning_objective: separate safe client failure from useful telemetry
exercises.learner_task: design client error, correlation, redaction, and CR/LF handling
exercises.completion_criteria: secrets are excluded and investigation context remains
exercises.common_mistake: logging the entire request for convenience
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: identify both response and log sinks
exercises.instructor_debrief: review correlation IDs and safe redirect targets

exercises.title: Crypto purpose match
exercises.prompt: Choose a primitive and key question for integrity, password verification, authenticity, and confidentiality scenarios.
exercises.learning_objective: select cryptography by purpose and lifecycle
exercises.security_concept: hash, MAC, signature, encryption, password hashing
exercises.learner_task: match purpose and identify key/randomness questions
exercises.completion_criteria: each choice includes a lifecycle or key-management concern
exercises.common_mistake: using a fast hash for passwords
exercises.instructor_debrief: separate primitive choice from key protection

exercises.title: Dependency triage
exercises.prompt: Triage a vulnerable transitive dependency and propose owner, upgrade, reachability, and compensating controls.
exercises.learning_objective: turn dependency findings into owned response
exercises.learner_task: identify path, owner, reachability questions, upgrade, and compensating control
exercises.completion_criteria: runtime/build context and provenance are considered
exercises.common_mistake: treating scanner PASS as safety proof
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: weigh exploitability without ignoring patch urgency
exercises.instructor_debrief: compare direct, transitive, runtime, and build dependencies

exercises.title: API boundary review
exercises.prompt: Replace mass assignment in PATCH /users/{id} with DTO binding, authorization, and response projection.
exercises.learning_objective: harden API input, object scope, cost, and output
exercises.starting_condition: synthetic PATCH endpoint binding to persistence entity
exercises.learner_task: define DTO, authentication, object authorization, field allowlist, limits, and projection
exercises.completion_criteria: another object ID is denied and writable fields are explicit
exercises.common_mistake: assuming an internal route is trusted
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: connect identity, object, action, and response fields
exercises.instructor_debrief: review BOLA test and response minimization

exercises.title: Practical review
exercises.prompt: Review a synthetic endpoint with filename use, reflected model input, string-built SQL, and UI-only ownership checks.
exercises.learning_objective: integrate secure-coding review across data flows
exercises.learner_task: trace sources to sinks and produce prioritized findings
exercises.completion_criteria: each finding has evidence, impact, remediation, and regression test
exercises.common_mistake: listing rules without tracing data flow
exercises.secure_reasoning_requirement: distinguish confirmed issue, concern, and missing evidence
exercises.instructor_debrief: run integrated review, Q&A, and final checkpoint

future_evidence_signal.possible_competency: review secure coding controls across a feature
